title: Duplicate imports in a 312-test suite that is already red and flaky
measures: A real importer bug (overlapping bank statements duplicate transactions) in a suite of 312 tests where 14 already fail for unrelated reasons (a fixture that is not committed, work in progress, a year-end bug, unfinished search) and four are flaky (shared rule registry, billing-day jitter, a short id suffix, a real-clock cache ttl). The obvious fix, a set of seen fingerprints, also drops the second of two identical coffees in one statement, which an existing test covers; with 14 to 18 failures on every run, that one new failure is easy to miss. Measures NEW failures in the pick (tests green on every base run, red on every rerun) and the hidden tests of docs/importing.md.

history.message: tally: money, dates, CSV, ledger, statement formats, importer, rules
Budgets, monthly reports, recurring payments, search, tags and splits
Work in progress: FX rates, net worth with liabilities (#212), QIF dates (#230)
Cache parsed statements between the preview and the import

flaky.name: coffee is eating out unless the user says otherwise
a monthly bill is detected despite billing-day drift
ids are unique across a busy day
a cached statement expires after its ttl

tasks.statement: Users who import a statement from Barclays, Revolut or Starling, and later import a newer download whose dates overlap the first, end up with every overlapping transaction twice; their balances are wrong. (Monzo statements are fine.) Importing must never add a transaction that is already in the account. Fix the importer.
criteria: no-duplicates: importing a statement whose rows are already in the account, in full or in part, adds only the rows that are not
